# Code of Conduct

We want Levuche's repositories to be a welcoming place for everyone who
takes part, whatever their experience, background or identity.

## What we expect

- Be kind and patient, especially with people who are new.
- Assume good intent, and ask before assuming.
- Give feedback on the work, not the person, and take it the same way.
- Keep discussions on topic and easy for others to follow.
- Respect people's time and privacy.

## What isn't OK

- Harassment, insults, threats or personal attacks
- Discriminatory jokes or language
- Sexual language or imagery
- Sharing someone's private information without their permission
- Spam, or repeatedly derailing a discussion

## If something happens

Report it to the maintainers privately. On any issue, pull request,
discussion or comment, use **…** › **Report content** to tell GitHub, or
contact the maintainers privately through the repository's **Security** tab
(**Report a vulnerability**), starting the title with "Conduct:". We read
every report, keep it confidential, and reply within a few working days.

Maintainers may edit or remove comments, lock threads, and block people who
don't follow this code, here and in Levuche's other repositories.

## Scope

This applies in all of Levuche's repositories, their issues, pull requests
and discussions, and anywhere someone represents the project.

Based on the ideas in the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/).
